digest.component_or_area: rebar code-review framework — four-pass seam integration
propositions: Project-declared code-review criteria were discovered by configuration but dropped at criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration surface, and CLI admission; this epic repairs all five drop-point seams.
Active project code-review criteria must run once in Round A, retain logical criteria id and physical reviewer_id, and use repository-effective Pass-3 routing with threshold and blocking controls.
The eval/calibration API and CLI must admit active code-review-only project criteria while rejecting inactive or ambiguous project identifiers.
Project-criterion runtime contract and extension architecture must be documented and proven via end-to-end unit tests spanning all four passes.

Eight dependency-ordered child tickets deliver resolver, fan-in/attribution, effective routing, eval/calibration, CLI admission, documentation, corpus/boundaries, and live-Gerrit dogfood with disjoint production file ownership.
This epic supersedes former umbrella jira-reb-1001, generic story 2c14-fa5f-1228-4e02, and bug 8a4b-e8b6-1bf9-48d8.
